note: skill_db.yml as SkillDatabase::parseBodyNode loads it, by skill ID, with skill_nocast_db.txt's flags in nocast. type is the BF_ value (0 for none), target the INF_ value (0 for passive), hit the DMG_ value. damage_flags, flags and unit flags are the NK_, INF2_ and UF_ names without their prefix. Every value with levels is a list of MAX_SKILL_LEVEL (13) values, filled past the listed levels as SkillDatabase::parseNode does. element holds ELE_ values, with ELE_WEAPON, ELE_ENDOWED and ELE_RANDOM for the special ones. cast_time_flags and cast_delay_flags are SKILL_CAST_ bits. requires.weapon and requires.ammo are bits of 1 << W_ and 1 << AMMO_, 0 for any. requires.items has 10 [item ID, amount] slots, filled as ItemCost is read. requires.status lists SC_ values. status is the SC_ value of Status, or -1. fixed_cast_time is only read in renewal.
